title: Traditional Song of the Highlands No. 60 (Rwai Shlur Ki Hima Vol. 9)
khasi_title: Rwai Shlur Ki Hima Ba-paka No. 60
cultural_context: Chronicles the defense of mountain states and ancestral autonomy. Passed down orally through generations of Khasi and Pnar families across Meghalaya.
lyrics_khasi:
Ka Tangmuri ka sawa ha suin,
Ki samla ki rynsied da ka kmen;
Ka shad suk mynsiem ka la sdang,
Ban ainguh ia U Blei Nongbuh Nongthaw.
lyrics_english:
The sacred Tangmuri pipe rings through the air,
The youthful dancers step forward in ecstasy;
The Dance of Peaceful Hearts has begun,
Giving thanks to God the Eternal Creator.
